I'm moving on to the structured output now: a Korean delivery note (거래명세서) from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, with the reference numbers and the 68,000-piece game card line.

The quantity of 68,000 pieces breaks down into 34 boxes of 2,000 each, and the 544 kg total weight lines up with it. I'm also checking the stamp, which partly covers the unit and box column, but both "PCS" and "34" are still readable, so I'll mark them as clear. The filename date is only a possible receiving date and isn't on the document itself, so I'll leave it out.
